messages.subject: Project Polaris - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Please find our first draft of the share purchase agreement. Key commercial points reflect the heads of terms. We've assumed a 25% liability cap, £30k de minimis and £350k basket, with general warranty claims at 24 months and tax at 7 years. Look forward to your mark-up.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0044
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Polaris - SPA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached. Main points: we've reduced the cap to 20%, lifted the basket to £500k (tipping to excess-only), shortened the tax limitation to 6 years, and tightened the pre-completion consent wording. Most other changes are clarificatory. Happy to talk it through.

Regards,
Jonathan Vane
Partner | Castle & Vane LLP
